def replay(n, cap, edges, rounds):
    E = len(edges)
    eu = [0] * E
    ev = [0] * E
    eping = [0] * E
    eack = [0] * E
    elabel = [""] * E
    for i, e in enumerate(edges):
        eu[i] = e["u"]
        ev[i] = e["v"]
        eping[i] = e["ping_us"]
        eack[i] = e["ack_us"]
        elabel[i] = e["label"]
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(E):
        adj[eu[i]].append(i)

    R = len(rounds)
    launch = [0] * R
    deadline = [0] * R
    hostdelay = [0] * R
    dhostack = [False] * R
    dpping = [None] * R
    dpack = [None] * R
    for r, ro in enumerate(rounds):
        launch[r] = ro["launch_us"]
        deadline[r] = ro["launch_us"] + ro["timeout_us"]
        hostdelay[r] = ro["host_delay_us"]
        dhostack[r] = ro["drop_host_ack"]
        dpping[r] = ro["drop_ping"]
        dpack[r] = ro["drop_ack"]

    source = 0
    dest = n - 1

    # metrics
    network_ping_tx = 0
    network_ack_tx = 0
    host_ack_tx = 0
    dedup_ping = 0
    capacity_drops = 0
    late_ping = 0
    ignored_ack = 0
    allocations = 0

    node_count = [0] * n
    cache_peak = [0] * n
    peak_entries = 0
    total_entries = 0

    entries = {}

    # per round outputs
    source_started = [False] * R
    source_final_us = [None] * R
    source_complete = [None] * R
    host_delivery_us = [None] * R
    source_proof = [None] * R

    heap = []
